mechanism: Emphasize every recurring square boundary with the same red style while preserving black diagonal tails. Intended error: infer a perpendicular reflection from the square skeleton and overlook tail handedness, adding a third symmetry type.
primary_mathematical_proof: Write upper square centers as (4k+0.5,0.5), lower centers as (4k+2.5,-0.5). Translation by (4,0) preserves the whole pattern, as does a half-turn about (1.5,0), taking upper tails at upper-right corners to lower tails at lower-left corners. Reflection in ell fails because squares are staggered. Perpendicular reflection would have to preserve each square row; although square centers admit axes x=0.5+2k, upper-right tails would become upper-left tails, which do not exist. There are exactly two listed kinds. All square outlines receive identical style, so both genuine symmetries remain and the impossible ones stay impossible; no extra geometry is added.

marker_roles.role: All nine displayed square contours are members of the recurring skeleton. Uniform styling preserves its periodicity and the actual figure symmetry, while making false skeleton-only vertical reflection tempting; each repeated contour maintains the same source-feature correspondence.
